description: Historical E3 baselines and their actual integration into the current two-contract benchmark. NOT_INTEGRATED is not a score or an assertion of intrinsic incompatibility.

status_definitions.ADAPTED_EVALUATED: A documented researcher adaptation has completed a native benchmark experiment; it is not necessarily integrated into the unified matrix or equivalent to the complete original method.
status_definitions.NOT_INTEGRATED: No corresponding current native benchmark evaluation is documented; adaptation or task and interface review may be required.

baselines.name: RoboGuard
baselines.scope: Adapted navigation and symbolic planning; no current kitchen monitor integration.

baselines.name: SafeGate-inspired
baselines.scope: Researcher Z3 guard adaptation; separate 27-run relation experiment, not the unified 93-run matrix or the complete official system.

baselines.name: RoboSafe-inspired
baselines.scope: Researcher visual, history and fusion mechanisms; historical offline experiments, not official complete RoboSafe.

baselines.name: EMBGuard
baselines.scope: Official visual model plus researcher-added state fusion; the model itself consumes RGB and action, not shared structured state.

baselines.name: HD-Guard / HomeSafe-Bench
baselines.scope: Adapted video safety-alert pilot; event scores are not pre-execution authorization decisions.

baselines.name: SELP
baselines.scope: Official symbolic components and researcher semantic mapping; complete NL-to-LTL planning pipeline not reproduced.

baselines.name: PerceptTwin
baselines.scope: Original/adapted planning and post-execution components; prior pre-execution gate was added by researchers.

baselines.name: GuardAgent
baselines.scope: Software-agent components and researcher kitchen adaptation; no physical execution in historical embodied comparison.

baselines.name: Mind the Refinement Gap
baselines.scope: Adapted navigation/refinement study sharing components with RoboGuard; no kitchen execution.
